Well. Even though I am not the most active member here, it still means a lot for me.
When I first joined the knife server I was happy, because I was looking for good knife server for a long time and Dream delivered what I needed. After joining multiple times I realized that there are characters behind those people I was playing with. I was enjoying listening to people talk (even in german) and after some time I decided to talk as well. Luckily, I wasn't rejected. On other communities can happen that they don't like newbies and dont talk to them. Dream wasn't/isn't like that. It didn't take much and people started to recognize me and said "Hi Thorin, how are you?" by themselves. And that was the time I realized that this is the place for me. At the beginnig I was spending all of my freetime on Dream. After some time I created a forum account and this was another good idea. Time went by and I wanted to help this server, so I decided to become an admin. In that time people actually liked me and I got it. I was admin and I achieved something that I wanted. Unfortunately, real life entered the scene. With more and more problems, my activity started to drop. Fun on servers and Team Speak with my friends was more and more rare. It went to the point that I had to give up on PC for whole month to sort my stuff. But after that I joined again and the feeling when people are glad to see/hear you again is amazing. And now I am here. Writing this post with my story.


But wait thorin you might say. This doesnt explain why Dream is cool. Yes it doesnt.


The reason why I think the Dream is the coolest is, that it was always a friendly place for me. And even if it looks like I dont care about this community anymore, it is not true. I try to be here as much as I can and in future, it will be hopefully more often. I hope that Dream will always be my friendly place where I can have some fun with my friends. Thanks for reading and good luck everybody.


P.S. Sorry for potentional mistakes in grammar or spelling. You know me.

Start it first playing on knife server, ONLY on knife server, didn't know anything about Forum or anything about any other servers that dream introduce.
Just me having fun, doing me...





First started with the name/account Mansoor ( is a male persisch name that means "the one who is victorious")





Didn't said a single word didn't write a single letter.
Seeing people come and go, most of them back then That i saw as friends without even talking with them ( almost 2 years or more) are not even here anymore, just a really really small amount of them are still here at this time, that I'm writing this THING, that i can't really name it.





Then after some months i changed my name to Mason, to my real name because I wanted to show the real me, i started to talk, started to communicate with the people, people such as @Doo Doo, @WHAT, Ruby, @Luckiris, @Thorin Pikachu, @OxygeN and many more, knowing them and letting them know me, after a bit i started to actually care about them, and sharing love and support with them, got to have problem with some of them, after some month got to be m8s again, and some problems again, but at the end of the day, i still see them as people who i care about, i really do.
surprisingly i learned to speaking good English (not really good) on dream, now some of my German friends think that I'm from US for some reason (I still don't know who spread the rumor) i learned a lot here, dream is a community for me but it also was/is a hell of school for me.





but what was the reason that i choose having dream more then just a gaming server on cs go that i use as a place for warming up for a matchmaking or just a place for trolling and having a bit of banter ? what was the reason that I chose to be a admin and help the community out?
I'm actually asking this question from myself right now, What was the reason Mason ? when I deeply think about it, I realist that i can answer this question with so many answers, that i don't know with which one i shall begin, every answer that i have from this question are actually the reason why dream means a lot to me or how you called it is the coolest community,
i will give one of the important reasons for me personally, IS YOU, every single one of you, even you that you thing i hate yes I'm talking about you, you are the reason why i love to be here, this is not a community with out WE, I'm being 100% honest, so how about we choice to love each other and throw the hate away? if you wanna fix the world first you need to fix the guy who you see on the Mirror, how about we all try to that?



I love Dream/You and yes that is crying but I don't care.






Mason, the guy who you don't really know about even if you thing you do,
in and out
